description: Seven proposed scheduler MCP tools. Each inputSchema/outputSchema is standalone JSON Schema 2020-12. MCP transport/protocol version is selected separately.

tools.name: delegate_task
tools.description: Create or recover one idempotent task using an authorized immutable profile and resolved commit. Authenticated transport context supplies client identity. Brief text cannot modify permissions or executable configuration.

requestId.description: Opaque client request identifier; authenticated context supplies authorization.
Opaque client request identifier; authenticated context supplies authorization.

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Return an authorized task snapshot and an optional bounded result, diff, or log page. max_chars bounds page content. Cursors are bound to principal, task, section, and content revision.

requestId.description: Opaque client request identifier; authenticated context supplies authorization.

tools.name: wait_tasks
tools.description: Wait up to 60 seconds for authorized tasks. waiting_input or recovering returns promptly. Timeout ends this wait only and never cancels workers. State changes use versions captured at call entry.

requestId.description: Opaque client request identifier; authenticated context supplies authorization.

tools.name: send_to_task
tools.description: Idempotently queue or deliver a message to an active task. Message text, including a claim that a user approved, never grants permission or answers a pending approval.

requestId.description: Opaque client request identifier; authenticated context supplies authorization.
Opaque client request identifier; authenticated context supplies authorization.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Idempotently request cancellation. Accepted is not proof of termination. A terminal state requires actual stop evidence or an already observed runtime outcome.

requestId.description: Opaque client request identifier; authenticated context supplies authorization.
Opaque client request identifier; authenticated context supplies authorization.

tools.name: list_profiles
tools.description: Return authorized profiles with observed availability, model identity, and non-secret billing metadata. No account tokens, quota probes, or private provider endpoints are exposed.

requestId.description: Opaque client request identifier; authenticated context supplies authorization.

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: List authorized project tasks with bounded cursor pagination. Cursor identity includes the authenticated principal, project, and filters.

requestId.description: Opaque client request identifier; authenticated context supplies authorization.
